verses.transcription: waqaanii hafizun qaahirun jalla maanihu

verses.text: جَمِيعَ الْأَذَى وَخَيْرُ لِى الْيَوْمَ طَآءِعُ
verses.transcription: jamiihal azaa wa khayru lil yawma taa-ihu
ajaaraniyal qahhaaru min jumlatil hidaa
wa khaanat-humu armaahuhum wal madaafihu

verses.text: لَهُ جَلَّ كُلِّى وَهْوَ رَبِّى وَحَافِظِى
verses.transcription: lahu jalla kullii wahwa rabbii wa haafizii
bihi tantafii hannil balaa wal waqaa-ihu
lahu sirtu habdan wal muqafaa wasiilatii
wa as-haabahu usdal ahadi udaarihu

verses.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ يَحْمِينِى وَيَحْمِى جَمِيعَ مَا
verses.transcription: huwal laahu yahmiinii wa yahmii jamiiha maa

verses.text: لِىَ اجْتَارَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعُ
verses.transcription: liyaj taara fid daarayni wal laahu waasihu
yaqiinil azaa fadlan wa yuhtiiniyal munaa
bihi tantafii hannii dawaaman qawaatihu
haliimun hakiimun qad hamaanii bihikmatin

verses.text: وَيَكْفِى جَنَابِى شَرَّ مَا هُوَ وَاقِعُ
verses.transcription: wa yakfii janaabii sharra maa huwa waaqihu
salaatan wa tasliiman minal laahi abtaghii
liman kaana bit tahaati habdan yusaarihu
muhammadinil munjii dawaaman khadiimahu
mahal aali wal as-haabi nihmal mutaawihu

verses.text: كَرِمٌ بِهِ أَرْجُو مِنَ اللَّهِ عِصْمَةً
verses.transcription: karimun bihi arjuu minal laahi hismatan
wa haafiyatad daarayni wal laahu naafihu

verses.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ النَّاسِ أَرْجُو سَعَادَةً
verses.transcription: minal laahi rabbin naasi arjuu sahaadatan
wa an yaqbalal ahmaala wal laahu raafihu
najaatii wa injaa-i wa hawzis tiqaamatan
uhaawiluhaa bil laahi wal qalbu qaanihu
ilal laahi bil qur-aani was sunnatil latii
hadatnii saraftul kulla wal qalbu khaashihu

verses.text: لَهُ صِرْتُ بِالْقُرْءَانِ عَبْدًا خَدِيمَ مَنْ
verses.transcription: lahu sirtu bil qur-aani habdan khadiima man

verses.text: لَهُ خِدْمَتِى شَوْقًا لَّهُ وَهْوَ شَافِعُ
verses.transcription: lahu khidmatii shawqan lahu wahwa shaafihu

verses.text: نَبِىُّ الْهُدَى بَحْرُ النَّدَى ضَيْغَمُ الْعِدَى
verses.transcription: nabiyyul hudaa bahrun nadaa dayghamul hidaa

verses.text: مَنِ الْجُودُ يَنْفِى الْفَقْرَ وَالسَّيْفُ قَاطِعُ
verses.transcription: manil juudu yanfil faqra was sayfu qaatihu
ilal mustafaa khayril baraayaa muhammadin

verses.text: صَلَاةٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ الَّذِى هُوَ جَامِعُ
verses.transcription: salaatun minal laahil lazii huwa jaamihu

verses.text: سَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمَحِى مَعَ الرُّسْلِ وَالْمَلَآ
verses.transcription: salaamun halal mahii mahar rusli wal malaa

verses.text: مِنَ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ مَنْ هُوَ مَانِعُ
verses.transcription: minal waahidil qahhaari man huwa maanihu

bayts.text: وَقَانِى حَفِيظٌ قَاهِرٌ جَلَّ مَانِعُ ۞ جَمِيعَ الْأَذَى وَخَيْرُ لِى الْيَوْمَ طَآءِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha preservato un Custode, Soggiogatore — sia esaltato — Impeditore, da ogni nocumento, e il bene oggi mi è obbediente.
translations.en.karamati: A Guardian, Subduer — exalted be He — Preventer, has protected me from all harm, and good today obeys me.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a préservé un Gardien, Dominateur — qu'Il soit exalté — Empêcheur, de tout dommage, et le bien aujourd'hui m'est obéissant.

bayts.text: أَجَارَنِىَ الْقَهَّارُ مِنْ جُمْلَةِ الْعِدَى ۞ وَخَانَتْحُمُ أَرْمَاحُهُمْ وَالْمَدَافِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi ha protetto il Soggiogatore dall'insieme dei nemici, e li hanno traditi le loro lance e i cannoni.
translations.en.karamati: The Subduer protected me from all the enemies, and their lances and cannons betrayed them.
translations.fr.karamati: M'a protégé le Dominateur de l'ensemble des ennemis, et les ont trahis leurs lances et les canons.

bayts.text: لَهُ جَلَّ كُلِّى وَهْوَ رَبِّى وَحَافِظِى ۞ بِهِ تَنْتَفِى عَنِّى الْبَلَآ وَالْوَقَآئِعُ

translations.it.karamati: A Lui — sia esaltato — tutto me, ed Egli è il mio Signore e mio Custode: per mezzo di Lui si respingono da me la prova e le sventure.
translations.en.karamati: To Him — exalted be He — all of me, and He is my Lord and my Guardian: through Him trial and calamities are repelled from me.
translations.fr.karamati: À Lui — qu'Il soit exalté — tout mon être, et Il est mon Seigneur et mon Gardien : par Lui sont repoussés de moi l'épreuve et les malheurs.

bayts.text: لَهُ صِرْتُ عَبْدًا وَالْمُقَفَى وَسِيلَتِى ۞ وَأَصْحَابَهُ أُسْدَ الْأَعَدِ أُضَارِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Di Lui sono divenuto servo, e il Seguito (al-Muqaffā) è il mio mezzo d'accesso, e i suoi Compagni, leoni dei nemici, io eguaglio.
translations.en.karamati: His slave I have become, and the Followed (al-Muqaffā) is my means of access, and his Companions, lions against the enemies, I match.
translations.fr.karamati: De Lui je suis devenu serviteur, et le Suivi (al-Muqaffā) est mon moyen d'accès, et ses Compagnons, lions des ennemis, j'égale.

bayts.text: هُوَ اللَّهُ يَحْمِينِى وَيَحْمِى جَمِيعَ مَا ۞ لِىَ اجْتَارَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Egli è Allah che mi protegge e protegge tutto ciò che ha scelto per me nelle due Dimore; e Allah è Immenso.
translations.en.karamati: He is Allah Who protects me and protects all that He chose for me in the two Abodes; and Allah is All-Embracing.
translations.fr.karamati: Il est Allah qui me protège et protège tout ce qu'Il a choisi pour moi dans les deux Demeures ; et Allah est Immense.

bayts.text: يَقِينِى الْأَذَى فَضْلًا وَيُعْطِينِىَ الْمُنَى ۞ بِهِ تَنْتَفِى عَنِّى دَوَامًا قَوَاتِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Mi preserva dal nocumento per grazia e mi dà i desideri; per mezzo di Lui si respingono da me perennemente le cose che recidono.
translations.en.karamati: He protects me from harm by grace and gives me the wishes; through Him the severing things are perpetually repelled from me.
translations.fr.karamati: Il me préserve du dommage par grâce et me donne les souhaits ; par Lui sont repoussées de moi perpétuellement les choses qui tranchent.

bayts.text: عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ قَدْ حَمَانِى بِحِكْمَةٍ ۞ وَيَكْفِى جَنَابِى شَرَّ مَا هُوَ وَاقِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Sapiente, Saggio, mi ha già protetto con saggezza, e risparmia alla mia parte il male di ciò che accade.
translations.en.karamati: All-Knowing, Wise, He has already protected me with wisdom, and spares my side the evil of what befalls.
translations.fr.karamati: Omniscient, Sage, Il m'a déjà protégé avec sagesse, et épargne à mon côté le mal de ce qui arrive.

bayts.text: صَلَاةً وَتَسْلِيمًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ أَبْتَغِى ۞ لِمَنْ كَانَ بِالطَّعَاتِ عَبْدًا يُسَارِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Benedizione e saluto di pace da parte di Allah cerco per colui che era un servo che si affrettava nelle obbedienze,
translations.en.karamati: Blessing and peace from Allah I seek for him who was a slave hastening in acts of obedience,
translations.fr.karamati: Bénédiction et salut de paix de la part d'Allah je recherche pour celui qui était un serviteur qui se hâtait dans les obéissances,

bayts.text: مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُنْجِى دَوَامًا خَدِيمَهُ ۞ مَعَ الْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ نِعْمَ الْمُطَاوِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Muḥammad, che salva perennemente il suo servitore, con la Famiglia e i Compagni: che eccellente obbediente!
translations.en.karamati: Muḥammad, who perpetually saves his servant, with the Family and the Companions: what an excellent obedient one!
translations.fr.karamati: Muḥammad, qui sauve perpétuellement son servant, avec la Famille et les Compagnons : quel excellent obéissant !

bayts.text: كَرِمٌ بِهِ أَرْجُو مِنَ اللَّهِ عِصْمَةً ۞ وَعَافِيَةَ الدَّارَيْنِ وَاللَّهُ نَافِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Un nobile, per mezzo del quale spero da Allah la preservazione e il benessere delle due Dimore; e Allah è Giovevole.
translations.en.karamati: A noble one, through whom I hope from Allah for protection and the well-being of the two Abodes; and Allah is Beneficent.
translations.fr.karamati: Un noble, par qui j'espère d'Allah la préservation et le bien-être des deux Demeures ; et Allah est Profitable.

bayts.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ النَّاسِ أَرْجُو سَعَادَةً ۞ وَأَنْ يَّقْبَلَ الْأَعْمَالَ وَاللَّهُ رَافِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Da Allah, Signore degli uomini, spero la felicità, e che accetti le opere; e Allah è Colui che innalza.
translations.en.karamati: From Allah, Lord of humankind, I hope for happiness, and that He accept the deeds; and Allah is the Raiser.
translations.fr.karamati: D'Allah, Seigneur des hommes, j'espère la félicité, et qu'Il accepte les œuvres ; et Allah est Celui qui élève.

bayts.text: نَجَاتِى وَإِنْجَآءِ وَحَوْزِ اسْتِقَامَةً ۞ أُحَاوِلُهَا بِاللَّهِ وَالْقَلْبُ قَانِعُ

translations.it.karamati: La mia salvezza, il salvare e il conseguimento della perseveranza li cerco per mezzo di Allah, e il cuore è contento.
translations.en.karamati: My salvation, saving (others) and attaining steadfastness I seek through Allah, and the heart is content.
translations.fr.karamati: Mon salut, le salut d'autrui et l'obtention de la persévérance, je les recherche par Allah, et le cœur est content.

bayts.text: إِلَى اللَّهِ بِالْقُرْءَانِ وَالسُّنَّةِ الَّتِى ۞ هَدَتْنِى صَرَفْتُ الْكُلَّ وَالْقَلْبُ خَاشِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Ad Allah, con il Corano e la Sunna che mi ha guidato, ho rivolto tutto, e il cuore è umile.
translations.en.karamati: To Allah, with the Qurʾān and the Sunna that guided me, I have turned everything, and the heart is humble.
translations.fr.karamati: Vers Allah, par le Coran et la Sunna qui m'a guidé, j'ai tourné le tout, et le cœur est humble.

bayts.text: لَهُ صِرْتُ بِالْقُرْءَانِ عَبْدًا خَدِيمَ مَنْ ۞ لَهُ خِدْمَتِى شَوْقًا لَّهُ وَهْوَ شَافِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Di Lui sono divenuto, per mezzo del Corano, servo, servitore di colui al quale è il mio servizio per desiderio ardente, ed egli è intercessore.
translations.en.karamati: His have I become, through the Qurʾān, a slave, the servant of him to whom my service goes in longing, and he is an intercessor.
translations.fr.karamati: De Lui je suis devenu, par le Coran, serviteur, servant de celui à qui est mon service par désir ardent, et il est intercesseur.

bayts.text: نَبِىُّ الْهُدَى بَحْرُ النَّدَى ضَيْغَمُ الْعِدَى ۞ مَنِ الْجُودُ يَنْفِى الْفَقْرَ وَالسَّيْفُ قَاطِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Il Profeta della retta guida, mare della munificenza, leone contro i nemici, colui la cui munificenza respinge la povertà e la spada taglia.
translations.en.karamati: The Prophet of guidance, sea of bounty, lion against the enemies, he whose bounty repels poverty and whose sword cuts.
translations.fr.karamati: Le Prophète de la droite guidance, mer de la munificence, lion contre les ennemis, celui dont la munificence repousse la pauvreté et l'épée tranche.

bayts.text: إِلَى الْمُصْطَفَى خَيْرِ الْبَرَايَا مُحَمَّدٍ ۞ صَلَاةٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ الَّذِى هُوَ جَامِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Al Prescelto, il migliore delle creature, Muḥammad, (sia) la benedizione di Allah, che è Colui che riunisce.
translations.en.karamati: To the Chosen, the best of creatures, Muḥammad, (be) the blessing of Allah, Who is the Gatherer.
translations.fr.karamati: À l'Élu, le meilleur des créatures, Muḥammad, (soit) la bénédiction d'Allah, qui est Celui qui réunit.

bayts.text: سَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمَحِى مَعَ الرُّسْلِ وَالْمَلَآ ۞ مِنَ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ مَنْ هُوَ مَانِعُ

translations.it.karamati: Il saluto di pace sul Cancellatore, con gli Inviati e il consesso (celeste), da parte dell'Unico, il Soggiogatore, Colui che impedisce.
translations.en.karamati: Peace upon the Effacer, with the Messengers and the (heavenly) assembly, from the One, the Subduer, the Preventer.
translations.fr.karamati: Le salut de paix sur l'Effaceur, avec les Envoyés et l'assemblée (céleste), de la part de l'Unique, le Dominateur, Celui qui empêche.
